run_relevance_classification: run the relevance classification script on a JSONL dataset using an LLM judge model
classify_false_refusals: classify retrieved support passages as Present or Absent using an OfflineModel and Jinja templates
parse_model_reply_label: parse an LLM reply string to extract a Present or Absent label using regex
run_main_cli: run the main CLI entry point with fire.Fire to classify a dataset in batches
review_classify_function: review the classify function that renders user messages from passages, questions, and answers for zero-shot classification
